ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") made as of the  day of October, 2019, by and between 511 West 35th Street LLC, having an address at c/o Spitzer Enterprises,730FifthAvenue,NewYork,NewYork,10019,511 West35thStreet Development LLC, having an address at c/o Spitzer Enterprises, 730 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York, 10019, and 517 West 35th LLC, having an address at c/o Related Companies, L.P., 60 Columbus Circle, New York, New York 10023 (collectively, the “Parties" and, each, a “Party"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, 511 West 35th Street LLC and 511 West 35th Street Development LLC, collectively, as tenants in common, are the owners of certain vacant land, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address as 511 West 35th Street, designated as Lots 26, 41, and 45 in Block 707 on the Tax Map of the City, County and State of New York (the "Tax Map"), as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Lot 26-45 Land"); WHEREAS, 517 West 35th LLC is the owner of certain vacant land, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address as 517 West 35th Street, designated as Lot 20 in Block 707 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Lot 20 Land"), and together with the Lot 26-45 Land, the "20-45 Land"); WHEREAS, the Parties acknowledge that the 20-45 Land will be subject to a certain Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement, to be recorded subsequent to this Agreement as of the date hereof, by and between (i) the Parties, (i) 451 Tenth Avenue LLC, as tenant of the Lot 31 Land under that certain Ground Lease, dated April 7, 2014, between Superpark Realty, LLC, as landlord, and 451 Tenth Avenue LLC, as amended by that certain First Amendment of Ground Lease, made as of June 23, 2017, and that Second Amendment of Ground Lease,made as of May 6, 2019, of certain vacant land in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address as 451 Tenth Avenue, New York, New York, designated as Lot 31 in Block 707 on the Tax Map (the “Lot 31 Land"), and (i) Superpark Realty, LLC, as owner of the WHEREAS, as a condition to the effectiveness of the Three-Party ZLDA, the Parties, 451 Tenth Avenue LLC, and Superpark Realty, LLC, shall utilize the procedure available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine Lots 20, 26, 31, 41 and 45 in Block 707 s0 as to create a combined zoning lot (the “Three-Party Zoning Lot") by execution and recording of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions; WHEREAS, subsequent to execution of the Three-Party ZLDA, 275,000 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights under Row C of Table A of Section 93-21 of the Zoning Resolution (the “Initial Row C Floor Area Development Rights") will be distributed to the Three- Party Zoning Lot by certification of the chairperson of the City Planning Commission in accordance with Section 93-34 of the Zoning Resolution;
